issues.finding: Legs swing as rigid plates; toes slide with the chassis instead of planting, pushing, lifting and stepping.
issues.status: Implemented: four eight-pose leg banks, alternating diagonal support and planted world-space toes; native alpha targets verified.

issues.finding: Swipes and gun bracing tilt the entire top-down actor; the feet do not establish a new support stance. This reads as rocking a card.
issues.status: Implemented: bounded continuous steering; body, native melee tips, guns, projectiles and warnings share one transform.

issues.finding: 21 jump states occupy 79.3 seconds. Dedicated chase/crawl states total only 8.5 seconds, so the spider spends little of this recording visibly walking.
issues.status: Implemented: walking between groups and fewer automatic swipe-to-jump continuations; native HP and warning windows retained.

issues.finding: After the first front leg breaks at 02:14.7, the chassis leans while the surviving legs keep the same sliding gait. Front pair ends at 03:39.5; rear pair ends at 04:56.3.
issues.status: Implemented: surviving legs retain the planted gait; destroyed parts remain absent from rendering and native targets.

issues.finding: Sustained hits refresh the core white overlay almost continuously, hiding the faceplate and attack detail. HP is still decreasing.
issues.status: Implemented: visible white hit pulses with authored color returning between sustained-hit pulses; native timers and expiry retained.

issues.finding: The organic background reads as a still picture. Existing very slow drift and faint code layers do not make its veins feel alive.
issues.status: Implemented: moving organic tissue bands, brightness pulses and native code layers on an independent clock.

issues.finding: The thin red beam does not fill the red eye aperture. The final socket override uses boss center rather than the visible eye in the current pose.
issues.status: Implemented: measured eye sockets in all 45 poses and an eight-frame red/white flare covering the eye, rooted to the native animated laser.

issues.finding: Claw FOV starts at a previous pose while shots use the moving raised claws. No distinct claw muzzle flash links each release to the arm. Repeats throughout the first host.
issues.status: Implemented: raised claw pose, exact shared FOV/muzzle sockets, visible native muzzle flashes and alternating shootable physical rockets/ordinary projectiles.

issues.finding: Destroyed right arm stays attached and darkened at 01:10.3; left arm at 01:44.2. Neither breaks off or shatters.
issues.status: Implemented per Mike's new approval: arms explode, break away and shatter into actual authored alpha fragments. Native part HP and protected core retained.

issues.finding: Ball movement stops during every horizontal beam tell/fire. Its route clock advances only while moving, leaving much of its four-point route unfinished before recovery. First active movement also jumps to the path start.
issues.status: Implemented: continuous full-field paths, smooth start, one permanent fold and no stopped horizontal beam cycles.

issues.finding: Bombs only appear after every second stopped laser cycle. This yields sparse aimed bombs instead of the requested trail left by a moving ball.
issues.status: Implemented: regularly dropped native shootable code bombs, four-active cap, 112-unit target spacing and native 1.8-second Furious reaction time.

issues.finding: Whole humanoid/ball becomes a solid white silhouette under repeated shots, masking pose, dead-arm state and attack details.
issues.status: Implemented: damaged arm/core pixels flash separately; ball pulses retain detail between hits. Native timers are preserved.

issues.finding: The falling explosion works, but the body produces no recognizable armor fragments moving away from it.
issues.status: Implemented: preserve the loved falling explosion and supplement it with opaque authored armor fragments; final native destruction also gets fragments.

issues.finding: The rebirth resolves into a fully solid held pose before the reveal. There is no visible accumulating data reconstruction or completion beat.
issues.status: Implemented: actual fusion plate reconstructs in digital scan bands while spinning, shows increasing download completion and settles upright at 100% before native whiteout/reveal.

issues.finding: The alleged lightning is a curved blue pinwheel/ring, including the same shapes in Mike's screenshots. It does not read as branching electrical bolts.
issues.status: Implemented: inspected authored branching blue bolts replace the rejected wheel in rebirth; exactly 24 accelerating native beats remain.

issues.finding: White whole-body hit plates also hide the final main form during attack tells. Copied Hammer, helicopter, brain and Volcano forms exhibit the same problem later.
issues.status: Partly improved: final main plate and Volcano now use readable hit pulses. Hammer, helicopter and brain native hit/effect composition remains a documented follow-up.

issues.finding: Portal, duplicate silhouettes, download helpers, FOV and large pickup labels overlap the main actor. 03:29–03:33 is a clear example.
issues.status: Visual/readability follow-up; authored final-form attack composition retained in this pass.

issues.finding: Repeated corner passes leave the Volcano mostly beyond the screen edge while large diagonal FOV fields remain visible. Examples: 07:51, 08:07–08:15, 08:27–08:29 and 08:49–08:59.
issues.status: Confirmed visually; separate later-form choreography issue, outside Mike's first-host/rebirth redesign.

issues.finding: The Hammer copy's red rage aura forms a hard rectangular-looking field around the body at 09:31. It obscures the silhouette.
issues.status: Confirmed visually; Stage8 copy retains its independent native owner; Stage5 fixes do not automatically apply here.

issues.finding: No health display during the entire twins fight. The first disabled sentinel dims but remains present; progress is difficult to judge amid the nebula and supply drops.
issues.status: Intentional source contract: health appears only after fusion, disabled twins wait at 1 HP. Readability proposal, not a stuck/immortal-boss bug.

issues.finding: Purple sentinel rounds compete with bright purple nebula branches and glowing supply drops; several shot lanes are hard to read at normal size.
issues.status: Visual/readability finding; a human dodge test is still needed before making a balance claim.

issues.finding: Fusion succeeds and both sentinels converge, but supply crates remain in front of the reveal. The center crate competes with the new hull.
issues.status: Confirmed visually; presentation polish proposal, native fusion logic works.

issues.finding: Tidal Sovereign spends most of its approximately 50-second fight near upper center; volleys change more than body choreography. Pickup labels repeatedly cover the attack field.
issues.status: Visual/design finding; no evidence of a stalled state machine.

issues.finding: Twin base hull is rotated by w.spin, but its blue hit overlay is drawn axis-aligned in the draw owner. This can create offset edges.
issues.status: Implemented: native blue overlay now shares hull rotation, fusion scale and disabled opacity; hidden twin HP and fusion rules remain intact.
